description:
Elite Estate Agents are proud to present this charming three bedroom cottage on a good site within walking distance of the beautiful village of Rosenallis, in the foothills of the Slieve Bloom Mountains.

This property comes to the market in excellent condition throughout and retains much of the traditional layout of an original Irish cottage. The surrounding views are stunning with the Slieve Bloom Mountains as the backdrop, the famous Glenbarrow Waterfalls, The Catholes and The Ridge of Capard are within a few short kilometres of Nutgrove.

The property comprises the following:

Entrance Porch - 1.8m x 1.2m
Ceramic floor tiles, light fitting

Kitchen/Dining Room - 4.3m x 3.7m
Ceramic floor tiles, fitted kitchen with large amount of storage facilities, tiled splash back, oven, hob, fridge/freezer, light fitting

Utility Room - 1.8m x 1.6m
Ceramic floor tiles, countertop space, fitted storage cupboards, washing machine, dryer, light fitting.

Living Room - 4.2m x 3m
Wood effect flooring, fireplace with large solid fuel stove, light fitting

Three Bedrooms:

Bedroom 1 - 3.1m x 3.4m
Wood effect flooring, wardrobe space, roller blind, light fitting

Bedroom 2 - 3.1m x 3m
Wood effect flooring, roller blind, light fitting

Bedroom 3 - 3.1m x 2.6m
Wood effect flooring, roller blind, light fitting

Bathroom - 2.7m x 2m
Ceramic floor tiles, wall tiles, bath, hand wash basin, WC, separate shower unit with electric shower, light fitting

Situated on a large site with sufficient space for an extension if desired, a garden and outbuildings.

LOCATION:

Rosenallis is a charming, historic village nestled at the foothills of the Slieve Bloom Mountains, surrounded by striking natural scenery. Just 4 kilometers away, you can reach the heart of the mountains via the Glenbarrow Waterfall and Trailhead, a popular starting point for scenic walks and hikes.

Nearby, you’ll find The Barrow Sauna, where visitors can unwind in a wood-fired sauna, relax in a hot tub, or refresh in cold plunge pools—all set within a peaceful natural landscape. Afterward, you can enjoy wholesome food and coffee at the family-run The Falls at Glenbarrow, making it an ideal spot to relax and take in the surroundings.

The local towns of Clonaslee, Mountmellick, Killeigh, Kinnity and Tullamore are all within a short driving distance of Rosenallis.

FACILITIES:

Churches, Creche, Primary School, Pub, Beauty Salon, Sports Facilities/GAA Ground and Walking Track

Viewing of this fantastic property is very highly recommended.
